headline: ARC-3 gold cutoff slips as the chase tightens

sections.text: The public ARC-3 gold line fell 0.22 in the past day to 37.98, the score for 19th place.
mikelou1 sits just outside the medal places in 20th at 37.27, 0.71 short of the cutoff.
